inlineImages.caption: Sugary drinks are causing an obesity epidemic in America!

bodyHtml:
I have spent a lot of time over the last 10 years of being a bariatric surgeon advising patients to avoid sugary drinks.  This is an excellent study that shows how bad they are for our society.   High-sugar liquids should be avoided, and this is why we have an obesity epidemic in America!

Trace Curry MD
